Title: [LSJ] Blood Fury, Soul Burn and weapon damage prevention

Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
I read some previous postings about this subject and i am a little bit
confused, so please help me clear this out.

1. Can i play blood fury when the opposing minion is at long range
just to get it out of my hand ? (i think no)
if yes, if the opposing minion strikes with a weapon from long
range, is the damage prevented ? (i think no)

2. If soul burn is dodged, does the "weapon inflict no damage" thing
take effect or not ? (i believe not)
Does soul burn prevents weapon damage only from additional strikes ?
or does it prevent weapon damage from the initial strike, too ?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Jyhad_addict" <geo...@for.auth.gr> wrote in message
news:c6a50f81.04092...@posting.google.com...

> 1. Can i play blood fury when the opposing minion is at long range
> just to get it out of my hand ? (i think no)

"No" is correct.
Card text: "Only usable at long range", supports your conclusion, yes.

> if yes, if the opposing minion strikes with a weapon from long
> range, is the damage prevented ? (i think no)

Moot.

> 2. If soul burn is dodged, does the "weapon inflict no damage" thing
> take effect or not ? (i believe not)

"Not" is correct. Dodge protects the dodger from all effects of the
strike.

> Does soul burn prevents weapon damage only from additional strikes ?
> or does it prevent weapon damage from the initial strike, too ?

From the currently-resolving strike (if any) and any further strikes
in the same round (if any).

That is, it negates weapon damage from the initial strike if Soul
Burn is also an initial strike and the weapon strike is not done
with first strike (the latter can be overcome by making the Soul
Burn strike also at first strike, of course).
